ErrorBody.description:
Standard error payload returned by every failed request.

The envelope is uniform across every error the server emits, including
routing fallbacks and extractor rejections (`API-039`). The `error_response`
helper builds it, and the root `hal_errors` middleware applies it to every
`4xx`/`5xx` response.

_links.description: Link to the request that produced the error.

GalleryItemDetailResponse.description: Detailed item of a gallery, returned by the item endpoints.

_links.description: Link to the item resource itself.

added_at.description: Date and time at which the item was added.

name.description: Name of the item: the image name, or the file path for a video.

GalleryItemResponse.description: One item of a gallery, without the metadata of its medium.

_links.description: Link to the item resource itself.

added_at.description: Date and time at which the item was added.

name.description: Name of the item: the image name, or the file path for a video.

GalleryItemType.description: Kind of the single medium a gallery item references.

GalleryLinks.description:
HAL links exposed by a gallery representation.

The `self` link addresses the gallery; the `items` link exposes the alias
path where its items are served (`API-037`).

items.description: Link to the item collection of the gallery.

self.description: Link to the gallery resource itself.

GalleryListLinks.description:
HAL links exposed by a gallery collection representation.

The `self` link addresses the collection view the representation is about,
`next` and `prev` navigate that same view when another page exists, and the
templated `search` link exposes the collection filters (`API-037`,
`API-042`). The active filters and the page size are carried into every link
so a filtered or paginated listing stays navigable.

oneOf.description: Link to the next page, when one exists.
Link to the previous page, when one exists.

search.description: Templated link exposing the collection's search filters.

items.description: The galleries of the returned page.

GalleryResponse.description:
Gallery returned by a successful lookup or creation.

On a collection listing, `items` stays empty and `item_count` communicates
the size of the gallery.

_links.description: Links to the gallery and its item collection.

created_at.description: Date and time at which the gallery was created.

is_public.description: Whether any authenticated user may read and moderate the gallery.

item_count.description: Number of items the gallery contains.

items.description: Items of the gallery, ordered by position.

last_modified_at.description: Date and time of the last modification of the gallery.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the owning user, absent for the system gallery.

_links.description: Link to the caller's user resource.

email.description: Email address of the caller, when one was provided.

username.description: Username of the user to authenticate.

Every attribute is optional; an omitted attribute leaves the stored value

email.description: Email address of the user, when one was provided.

PutUploadChunkRequest.description:
Raw bytes of one chunk.

The handler extracts the body as raw bytes. It is declared as a binary
`String` so the `OpenAPI` schema describes the raw `application/octet-stream`
payload instead of the JSON array of integers a bare `Vec<u8>` would produce.

RegisterRequest.description:
Payload to register a new user.

The requested `role` is granted only when the authenticated caller is
allowed to create it: the Root Admin can register `Admin` or `Standard`
users, an `Admin` user can register `Standard` users only.

email.description: Email address of the new user, when provided.

password.description:
Password of the new user; never returned by the API.

Must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one symbol
(a non-alphanumeric character).

role.description: Role to grant to the new user.

RegisterResponse.description: User created by a successful registration.

_links.description: Link to the newly registered user resource.

email.description: Email address of the newly registered user, when one was provided.

id.description: Unique identifier of the newly registered user.

role.description: Role granted to the newly registered user.

username.description: Username of the newly registered user.

SelfLinks.description:
The `self` link of a HAL representation.

Every resource representation carries the URI it was served from, so clients
never construct or hardcode it themselves (`API-032`, `API-037`).

UploadSessionLinks.description:
HAL links exposed by an upload-session representation.

The `self` link addresses the session itself; the templated `chunk` link
lets clients discover where to store a chunk instead of building the URL
from the identifiers (`API-037`); the `complete` link lets clients discover
how to finish the session.

chunk.description: URI template for storing one chunk of the upload session.

self.description: Link to the upload-session resource itself.

UploadSessionResponse.description: State of an upload session returned by a successful lookup or chunk store.

_links.description: Links to the upload session, its chunk endpoint and its completion.

bitmap.description: One character per chunk, `1` when received and `0` otherwise.

expires_at.description:
Date and time at which the upload session expires, as
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`.

oneOf.description:
Unique identifier of the caller's file for the session digest, when one
exists.

is_finished.description: Whether the upload session has been finished.

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks the upload is split into.

UserListLinks.description: HAL links of a user collection representation.

search.description: Templated link exposing the collection's search filters.

info.title: Mnemorium API

post.description:
Validates the declared content type, file name, size and integrity hash,
creates the upload session and its staging file, and returns the session
identifier, the fixed chunk size and the expiry instant.

Location.description: Canonical URI of the created upload session

400.description: Malformed request body or invalid integrity hash

Allow.description: HTTP methods accepted by this path

413.description: The declared file size or the request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The declared content type is not a supported media type

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema, or the file name or size fails validation

get.description:
Returns the received-chunk bitmap, the total number of chunks, the expiry
instant, whether the upload is finished and the identifier of the caller's
file for the session digest, when one exists. The file identifier is
reported whether or not the session is finished: a caller-scoped duplicate
completion leaves the session open and returns this same identifier.

An expired session is reported as `404`, exactly like an unknown one, so a
retried read never changes the result. As a side effect the read lazily
deletes the expired session's row and staged file before answering.

parameters.description: Identifier of the upload session
parameters.name: upload_id

Allow.description: HTTP methods accepted by this path

get.summary: Fetch the state of an upload session

put.description:
The request body carries the raw bytes of the chunk. The `Content-Range`
header declares the inclusive byte range as `bytes {start}-{end}/{total}` and
the `Content-Digest` header carries the SHA-256 digest of the body as an RFC
9530 Byte Sequence, `sha-256=:<base64>:`. The chunk's `start` is validated
against the chunk size persisted when the session began, not the current
configuration. The chunk is idempotent: re-uploading it with the same digest
succeeds without changing the stored content.

parameters.description: Identifier of the upload session
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.description: Zero-based number of the chunk
parameters.name: chunk_number

parameters.description: Inclusive byte range, `bytes {start}-{end}/{total}`
parameters.name: Content-Range

parameters.description: RFC 9530 content digest of the chunk, `sha-256=:<base64 of the raw 32-byte digest>:`
parameters.name: Content-Digest

400.description: Malformed identifier, chunk number or header syntax

Allow.description: HTTP methods accepted by this path

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum chunk size

422.description: The chunk number, range or digest fails validation

post.description:
The upload identifier is carried by the path; there is no request body. The
staged content's integrity hash is recomputed and verified against the hash
declared when the upload was initialized. When the caller already owns a
file with that hash, no second copy is stored: the existing file's
identifier is returned and the upload session is left unfinished. Otherwise
the staged file is promoted, its record registered, and the upload marked
finished. Completion is idempotent: completing an already finished upload
returns the caller's file for the same digest.

parameters.description: Identifier of the upload session
parameters.name: upload_id

Allow.description: HTTP methods accepted by this path

422.description: The upload is incomplete or its integrity does not match

get.description: Returns `200` with the current health status when the service is running.

patch.description:
Only the Root Admin (user identifier `0`, role `Admin`) may invoke this
endpoint; any other authenticated caller is rejected with `403`. The Root
Admin may change its own credential as well as the credential of any other
user. The new password must satisfy the password policy: at least 8
characters long and containing at least one symbol.

parameters.description: Identifier of the credential whose password is changed
parameters.name: id

403.description: Caller is not the Root Admin

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema, or the new password violates the password policy

patch.summary: Change the password behind a credential

post.description:
The caller presents a username and a password. On success the endpoint
returns an access token to present in the `Authorization` header of
subsequent requests, together with the number of seconds it stays valid.

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema

post.description:
The Root Admin (user identifier `0`) may register `Admin` or `Standard`
users; an `Admin` user may register `Standard` users only; any other role is
rejected with `403`.

Location.description: URI of the newly registered user

403.description: Insufficient privileges to register the requested role

409.description: Username or email is already taken

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema, or the username, email or password fails validation

get.description:
Any authenticated caller may list galleries: public galleries are visible to
all, private galleries only to their owner and administrators. The
collection is paginated and filterable, and returned as a HAL collection
with navigation and search links.

parameters.description: Only return galleries whose public flag matches this value.
parameters.name: is_public

parameters.description: Maximum number of galleries to return, between 1 and 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only return galleries whose name matches this value.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number of matching galleries to skip before returning the page.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Only return galleries owned by this user.
parameters.name: owner_id

422.description: The limit is out of range

post.description:
Any authenticated caller may create a gallery. The name is required, trimmed
and at most 100 characters long; `is_public` defaults to `false`.

Location.description: URI of the newly created gallery

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The gallery name is empty or too long

delete.description:
Only the owner of the gallery may delete it; administrators have no
override. The seeded default gallery (identifier `0`) is never deletable and
answers `409`. Deletion is permanent.

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery to delete
parameters.name: id

403.description: Caller is not the owner of the gallery

409.description: The default gallery cannot be deleted

get.description:
Any authenticated caller may read a public gallery; a private gallery is
readable by its owner and administrators only. The representation carries
the gallery and its items, ordered by position.

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery to fetch
parameters.name: id

403.description: Caller is not allowed to read the gallery

get.description:
This route is a true alias of `GET /library/gallery/{id}`: it returns the
same gallery representation, and the `_links.self` of that representation is
the canonical gallery URI, never this alias path (`API-042`).

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery whose items are listed
parameters.name: id

403.description: Caller is not allowed to read the gallery

get.summary: List the items of a gallery

post.description:
Any authenticated caller may add an item to a public gallery; a private
gallery accepts items from its owner and administrators only. A caller may
only add media it owns, unless it is an administrator. A medium already in a
gallery is rejected with `409`.

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery the media is added to
parameters.name: id

Location.description: URI of the newly added item

400.description: Invalid gallery identifier or malformed request body

403.description: Caller may not add items to the gallery, or does not own the medium

409.description: The medium already belongs to a gallery

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema

post.summary: Add an item to a gallery

delete.description:
Any authenticated caller may delete an item of a public gallery; an item of
a private gallery may be deleted by the gallery owner and administrators
only. The item is scoped to the gallery named in the path. Deletion is
permanent and removes the medium and its backing file.

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery the item belongs to
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Identifier of the item to delete
parameters.name: item_id

403.description: Caller is not allowed to delete items of the gallery

get.description:
Any authenticated caller may read an item of a public gallery; an item of a
private gallery is readable by the gallery owner and administrators only.
The item is scoped to the gallery named in the path.

parameters.description: Identifier of the gallery the item belongs to
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Identifier of the item to fetch
parameters.name: item_id

403.description: Caller is not allowed to read the gallery

the optional filters as a HAL collection. An empty list is a valid outcome.

Requires an `Admin` caller. Returns the profile — identifier, username,

patch.description:
Requires an `Admin` caller. The root admin (identifier `0`) cannot be
updated by anyone. A non-root `Admin` may update its own profile (username
and email) but may not modify another admin; it may update standard users
of the instance. Only the Root Admin may change the role of a user.

parameters.description: Identifier of the user to update
parameters.name: id

400.description: Invalid user identifier or malformed request body

403.description: Caller is not an administrator, the target cannot be modified, or the role change is not allowed

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The request body does not match the expected schema, or the username or email fails validation
